_note: Flow + selector map for the claude adapter. Data, not code: fix UI drift here. Regex strings are case-insensitive.

auth._note: Browser-layer facts: which cookie proves a signed-in session (name or name prefix), which cookies are merged back into the master when a run rotates them (refresh), which hosts hold session state, and which SSO hosts are carried along when seeding.

signIn._note: cc browser signin (src/browser/signin.ts): the login page, its Google button, and the account endpoint that confirms which email is signed in. accountEmailField is a dot path into that endpoint's JSON.
